title: No proprietary right in highway.
bodyText: No certificate or permit issued under this chapter confers any proprietary or property right in the use of the public highways.
bodyHtml: §271-14  No proprietary right in highway.  No certificate or permit issued under this chapter confers any proprietary or property right in the use of the public highways. [L 1961, c 121, pt of §2; Supp, §106C-12; HRS §271-14]
